breakdown.title: The Library Underwater
breakdown.logline: In an old library, floodwater rises until books float open like birds; the dreamer's sister rows a small yellow boat past a whale, to a high round window opening onto a drowned, peaceful city.

colours.value: green glass lamps, dark wood, yellow boat, morning light on water

light.value: dim interior lamplight, then bright morning light through the window

breakdown.world_logic: Water rises inside a library, a whale swims through flooded aisles, and the world outside is completely underwater, all accepted calmly.

In the foreground, a yellow rowing boat fills the lower part of the frame from left third to right third, with the dreamer on the left and the older sister on the right, both seen from behind and full figure; desks with green glass lamps sit in front of the boat, partially hiding its lower hull. The reading room fills the background behind the desks and window. Light comes from the green glass lamps on the desks and from the high round window. Just outside the frame to the left are the left door, a bookshelf, and the rising water with floating books; to the right are the right door and another bookshelf.
